research.job_description_summary: NVIDIA hires new graduates in India as Software Engineers. An October 2025 Jointaro account describes an online assessment with C/C++ output-prediction questions and coding problems, with a CGPA cut-off above 7.8. An October 2025 intern account lists topics such as bit manipulation, hashing, DP, computer organisation, OS, DBMS and puzzles. Later technical rounds are inferred from editorial guidance as C++, GPU/CUDA fundamentals and design. The official careers page was not fetched.
limitations: NVIDIA's official careers page was not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED.

Candidate-attributed material is one October 2025 online-assessment account (CGPA cut-off above 7.8) and one October 2025 intern topic list; items based on them carry one report each and are unverified.
GPU/CUDA, C++ and design items rest on unattributed GeeksforGeeks-style guidance and are original practice (class D).
Research-intern Glassdoor reviews found were non-India and were excluded.
Round structure beyond the online assessment is inferred.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
